bead.title: Remove or narrow redundant memory bespoke positive commit-transition test
bead.description:
PROBLEM
After the shared commit-transition scenario from governing artifact/dependency pqueue-c42136f3 is wired into memory backend coverage, the bespoke memory positive-path test remains and may duplicate or diverge from the shared contract.

ROOT CAUSE
crates/pqueue-memory/src/tests.rs:69 defines vectorized_commit_recovery_and_side_records_round_trip, a bespoke positive-path test intended to be covered by the shared scenario.

PROPOSED FIX
After pqueue-c42136f3 and the child bead wiring memory positive coverage are complete, delete vectorized_commit_recovery_and_side_records_round_trip from crates/pqueue-memory/src/tests.rs if the shared memory scenario covers the exact behavior. If any portion covers behavior outside the shared scenario, retain only that portion under a narrower test name with a comment identifying the out-of-scope behavior. Leave tests whose behavior is not covered by the shared scenario, including idempotency, bad-token/version, fence, capability, request-id propagation, or explain-commit coverage not proven redundant.

NON-SCOPE
Do not implement real CommitTransitionPort behavior for postgres/objectlog; that is a separate epic. Do not delete any bespoke test unless its exact behavior is covered by the shared harness. Do not delete schema_validation_rejects_before_append_and_idempotency_on_sqlite_relational. Do not relax any verification gate. Do not remove pqueue-0ef6807b postgres/objectlog bespoke decline tests in this bead unless the shared decline harness has already been wired and the deletion is proven behavior-preserving.

DEPENDENCIES
Requires pqueue-c42136f3 and completion of the child bead wiring memory positive coverage. Parent: pqueue-54039317. Split from parent bead pqueue-d2f0b763.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestMemoryBespokePositiveRemovedOrJustified: `rg -c 'fn vectorized_commit_recovery_and_side_records_round_trip' crates/pqueue-memory/src/tests.rs` returns `0`, or any retained portions are renamed/narrowed with comments showing they cover behavior outside the shared scenario.
2. TestMemoryNonScopeRetained: memory backend tests for idempotency, bad-token/version, fence, capability, request-id propagation, or explain-commit behavior not proven redundant remain present and passing.
3. TestCargoWorkspaceGate: `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features` passes after the deletion or narrowing.
4. TestGoWorkspaceGate: `go test ./...` passes or is documented as not applicable because the repository has no Go packages.
5. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
6. TestRustStyleGate: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
